about: Audio slots for the NavisLabs final film. Each slot plays FINAL first, then TEMP, then nothing. Drop Abhishek's recorded lines into public/voiceover/final/Lxx.wav (and a mixed score into public/music/final/score.wav) — no code change. start_s is when a line begins; end_s is the expected end of a calm, natural read; ceiling_s is the latest it may still be playing. Temp files (scripts/make-temp-audio.py) are a neutral system voice and synthesized music/SFX — placeholders only.
direction: Abhishek's own voice: calm, deep, precise, confident, technical, understated. Let the pauses stay; important words land on the picture (see 'shows').

voiceover.text: Every company already has an operating memory.
voiceover.shows: A single line of light forms in the dark: the company's memory, before it has any detail.
A DECISION signal attaches to the line: 'Annual plans keep their current terms' (Meet, Sep 30).
A CUSTOMER signal: 'Acme Corp renews Nov 14' (Drive).
A COMMITMENT signal: 'Revised terms promised to Acme by Oct 3' (Slack).
A MEETING signal: 'Acme quarterly review' (Google Calendar).
A CONTEXT signal: the Acme renewal thread (Gmail). Five signals now sit on one line.

voiceover.text: But it's scattered across the systems where work happens.
voiceover.shows: The line breaks; each signal flies back into the system it lives in: Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Meet, Google Drive, Google Docs, Slack.
Six separate systems, nothing connecting them.

voiceover.text: People spend their time reconstructing context.
voiceover.shows: PEOPLE: a cursor copies pieces from each system into a note, one at a time.

voiceover.text: AI agents start with almost none of it.
voiceover.shows: AGENTS: a new agent session — company context: —, decisions: —, open work: —.

voiceover.text: So every new task begins with the same question:
voiceover.shows: A task is typed into Claude Code: 'Update renewals so annual plans keep their current terms.'

voiceover.text: What does this company already know?
voiceover.shows: The question, large, on black.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs is building the layer that answers it.
voiceover.shows: The NavisLabs lockup appears; the line draws beneath it.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs turns the signals across your company into a shared understanding of how your organization works.
voiceover.shows: The six systems connect; their signals flow into NavisLabs; ONE SHARED UNDERSTANDING; people, customers, decisions, commitments, projects, meetings.
NAVIS APPLICATION · for people. Navis Application's Today page rises: 'Good morning, Abhishek.'
Macro: the What changed section — a verified 'Just learned' card.
Macro: Waiting on you — '1 person is waiting on your reply'.
Click 'Why this matters' on the Acme card: the 'Why Navis surfaced this' drawer, then its evidence with SOURCE · TIMELINE · FRESHNESS.
'What you can do' → 'Review & reply' → 'Review draft' → 'Preparing the draft…'.

voiceover.text: For developers and AI agents, there's Navis Developer.
voiceover.shows: Hard cut: NAVIS DEVELOPER · for developers + AI agents. Abhishek's VS Code on the NavisLabs repository, Claude Code in the terminal, the task being typed.

voiceover.text: Give an agent the right company context,
voiceover.shows: navis_get_relevant_context returns ACME CORP: decision, customer, commitment, owner, last response — each with source and freshness.
macOS Terminal, DAY 2 · new session: NAVIS WORK CONTINUITY restores CURRENT TASK / DECISIONS / OPEN.
Two keys: AUTHORIZED, then DENIED with the exact refusal.

voiceover.text: so it can actually work inside your organization.
voiceover.shows: The agent continues: the change lands in renewals.ts; the run is on record in Navis Developer.
Type card on black.
Type card on black.

voiceover.text: A shared understanding for your company — used by both people and agents.
voiceover.shows: HERO: Navis Application (people) and Navis Developer (developers + AI agents) either side of NavisLabs; the same Acme signal travels through both; ONE SHARED UNDERSTANDING.
'Models will change.'
'Agents will change.'

voiceover.text: But how your company works is yours.
voiceover.shows: What is specific to the company — people, customers, decisions, commitments, projects, meetings — holds, then gathers into NavisLabs.
End card: NAVISLABS.

music.style: San Francisco late-night engineering: low drones, restrained electronic pulse, warm pads, one piano note. No trailer hits, no 'AI corporate' bed.

sections.brief: a subtle pulse enters under the problem
NavisLabs: a low swell, then the systems connect
developer rhythm, restrained electronic texture — Navis Developer
build through the hero shot and the closing thought

music.note: The brief asked for developer rhythm at 30–60 and the human section at 60–82; the master voiceover introduces Navis Application first, so the human and developer sections follow the voice order instead.

sfx.style: Understated: keyboard, terminal enter, cursor clicks, UI confirmations, one notification, two soft air transitions. The viewer should barely notice them.
